title: misaale badr jo haasil hua kamaal
body:
misaale badr jo haasil hua kamaal mujhe
ghata ghata ke falak ne kiya hilaal mujhe
<<DIVIDER>>
teri madad ka faqat ya Ali bharosa hai
kisi ki aaas nahi waqte inteqaal mujhe
<<DIVIDER>>
kareem jo tujhe dena ho be talab dede
faqeer hoo'n pa nahi aadate sawaal mujhe
<<DIVIDER>>
kisi ke saammne kyu'n haath jaake phailaaoo'n
mera kareem to deta hai be sawaal mujhe
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain kehte the pushte faras se girta hoo'n
madad ka waqt hai ae bekasi sambhaal mujhe
<<DIVIDER>>
Hussain kehte the parwardigaar rahiyo gawaah
ke qatl karte hai na haq ye bad qisaal mujhe
